text: 日前，中国人民银行开展证券、基金、保险公司互换便利操作，本次操作金额1000亿元，采用费率招标方式，31家证券、基金公司参与投标，中标费率为10bp。本次操作中，中金公司中标共计163亿元。
text_en: The People's Bank of China recently conducted a Securities, Funds and Insurance Companies Swap Facility (SFISF) operation totaling 100 billion yuan, using a rate bidding method. Thirty-one securities and fund companies participated in the bidding, with a winning rate of 10bp. In this operation, CICC won a total of 16.3 billion yuan.
